scoring_justification: Both MAE and Adjusted Rand Index can be recomputed directly from the raw submitted CSV tables without any external data or training.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold clustering labels for method_clusters.csv; MAE thresholds for test_predictions.csv derived from paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 2a and abstract claim MAE<0.1 kcal/mol; dendrogram clusters from Figure 2b.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Threshold set to 0.10 kcal/mol per method per paper's explicit claim of MAE below 0.1 kcal/mol; gold clusters correspond to theoretical families: HF, MP2, SAPT, DFT (B3LYP/B2PLYP).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Threshold derived from paper's explicit numerical claim; gold clusters derived from paper's reported dendrogram groupings.

outputs.description: Test‑set predictions and true ΔE values for the five methods. The checker recomputes per‑method MAE and compares to hidden thresholds.
Cluster assignments for the five methods from hierarchical clustering. The checker computes adjusted Rand index against hidden expected groupings.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes MAE from the test_predictions.csv and compares each to a hidden threshold (threshold_or_better logic). For method_clusters.csv, the checker computes adjusted Rand index between the submitted labels and hidden expected clusters, requiring a high value for full credit.
